justification: The line graph of the Petersen graph is Hamiltonian. Label Petersen edges e_i=a_i a_{i+1}, s_i=a_i b_i, f_i=b_i b_{i+2}, with indices modulo 5. Its line graph has Hamiltonian cycle (e0,s1,e1,s2,e2,e3,s3,f3,f1,f4,s4,f2,f0,s0,e4,e0): every edge appears once, and consecutive edges share an endpoint. The objection to Step 7 correctly identifies a proof gap but does not refute the statement.
